mentions.heading: Incorporating AI tools may subject us to competitive, legal, regulatory and other risks
mentions.detail: Risks from flawed algorithms, IP and data loss, competitors' superior AI use, and emerging AI laws
mentions.quote: The jurisdictions in which we conduct business have and may adopt laws and regulations related to AI, which could cause us to incur greater compliance costs, limit our use of AI tools, or subject us to legal liabilities.

mentions.heading: We may be unable to attract and retain highly skilled personnel.
mentions.detail: Intense competition for experienced semiconductor design engineers; tight labor markets; most employees lack employment agreements
mentions.quote: In the semiconductor industry, the competition for qualified personnel, particularly experienced design engineers and other technical employees, is intense. Furthermore, we have operations in many parts of the world that are currently experiencing a tight labor market for skilled employees.

mentions.heading: Warranty claims, product liability claims, product recalls, and contract non-compliance could harm our business
mentions.detail: Manufacturing impurities can cause defects; OEMs increasingly expect suppliers to warrant products and contribute to recalls
mentions.quote: As suppliers become more integrally involved in electrical design, OEMs are increasingly expecting them to warrant their products and are looking to them for contributions when faced with product liability claims or recalls.

mentions.heading: Warranty claims, product liability claims, product recalls, and contract non-compliance could harm our business
mentions.detail: Defects may trigger customer-chain consequential damages exceeding product revenue; contractual liability limits may fail
mentions.quote: Since a defect or failure in our products could give rise to failures in the goods that incorporate them (and claims for consequential damages against our customers from their customers), we may face claims for damages that are disproportionate to the revenue and profits we receive from the products involved.
